D: After their grandmother dies, a grieving family uncovers what she left behind.
P: Serve the mains at the family dinner where nobody holds back.
S: Tiny egg and cress, cucumber cream cheese and ham Dijon sandwiches
Crustless finger sandwiches of egg and cress, cucumber and cream cheese, and ham and mustard, cut into exact little squares and stood up like a model.
tiny squares of cheddar, brie and blue set out to scale, quince paste and honeyed walnuts

Tiny squares of aged cheddar, brie and blue arranged like rooms on a board, with mini lavash crackers, quince paste, grapes and honeyed walnuts. Toss 80g walnuts with 1 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt and bake at 180C for 8 minutes, then cool. Cut 150g aged cheddar, 150g brie and 100g blue cheese into small neat squares. Arrange them in a grid of little rooms on a large board, with 100g quince paste cut into cubes, 1 small bunch grapes, the walnuts and a packet of mini lavash crackers in the hallways.
Sunflower, pumpkin, sesame and chia crackers. Click, click.

Crisp baked crackers made from sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, with a beetroot dip. Mix 80g each of sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds with 2 tbsp chia, 250ml water and salt and stand 15 minutes.
M: dry-brined bird, crisp skin, roast potatoes, greens and lemon thyme gravy, served in silence

Dry-brined roast chicken with crisp skin, roast potatoes, buttered greens and a sharp lemon and thyme pan gravy, served at a very quiet table. Salt a 1.8kg chicken all over and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 45 to 50 minutes until the thigh hits 75C, and rest 15 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in 60ml oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Make gravy with the juices, 1 tbsp flour, 300ml stock and lemon. Steam 300g green beans with butter.
Chicken thighs, mushrooms and leeks in a white wine cream sauce
Chicken thighs, mushrooms and leeks in a white wine and cream sauce, topped with puff pastry, egg washed and baked at 200C for 30 minutes until puffed.
W: Dense dark chocolate cake, glazed. Does that have nuts? No.
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked at 170C for 35 minutes, glazed with ganache. Check every label for nuts.
K: Shiraz sangria with cherries, orange, cinnamon and brandy

Shiraz steeped with dark cherries, orange and cinnamon, lifted with brandy and a splash of soda, poured over ice in heavy glasses. Put 300g pitted cherries (frozen is fine), 1 sliced orange and 1 cinnamon stick in a jug. Add 750ml Shiraz, 60ml brandy and 2 tbsp caster sugar and stir to dissolve. Chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add 300ml soda water and stir. Pour into 4 heavy glasses over ice with some of the fruit in each.

s.note: Tiny egg and cress, cucumber cream cheese and ham Dijon sandwiches
s.how: Boil 3 eggs and mash with mayo and cress. Make sandwiches of egg, cucumber with 100g cream cheese, and 100g ham with Dijon, using 12 slices white bread. Cut off the crusts and cut into exact little squares. Stand them up in rows.

s.note: Sunflower, pumpkin, sesame and chia crackers. Click, click.
s.how: Mix 80g each of sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds with 2 tbsp chia, 250ml water and salt and stand 15 minutes. Spread thin on a lined tray and bake at 160C for 50 minutes, then break up. Blitz 250g cooked beetroot with 150g Greek yoghurt for the dip.

m.note: Chicken thighs, mushrooms and leeks in a white wine cream sauce
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then soften 250g mushrooms and 2 sliced leeks. Add 150ml white wine and 200ml cream and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Tip into a dish, cover with puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: Dense dark chocolate cake, glazed. Does that have nuts? No.
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 200g sugar, fold in the chocolate and 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes. Pour over 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream. Check every label for nuts first.

Chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add 300ml soda water and stir. Pour into 4 heavy glasses over ice with some of the fruit in each.
